what: ki-ốt công viên: the light blue kiosk with a red sign and a green roof on the sidewalk of the park of Bãi Trước on Quang Trung
uses: Plan 0026: the kiosks on the sidewalk of the park on Quang Trung (the place in 2019 is Q2: Check).

drawing.name: ki_ot_cong_vien
sources: The light blue kiosk with a red sign on the sidewalk of the park of Bãi Trước on Quang Trung: the photo of 2014-04-06 (Commons, trungydang, CC BY 3.0); the sizes at the scale of a scooter beside it (Vũng Tàu, data/world/drawings/ki_ot_cong_vien.json). No letters: the words of the sign cannot be read.

sources.author: trungydang
sources.shows: Quang Trung to the south, by the park: on the sidewalk of the park, a light blue green kiosk of panels with a red sign band under a low green roof, a scooter and a stone bench beside it, Terminalia trees, blue lamp poles.

width.source: Photo 0 (2014): the body is 46 px wide, and the scooter beside it on the same line of the sidewalk is 26 px high (about 1.05 m, the height of a scooter to its bars): 1.9 m.

depth.source: estimate (no source): photo 0 shows the kiosk from its end.

body_height.source: Photo 0 (2014): 53 px from the sidewalk to the foot of the sign, at the scale of the scooter (26 px for 1.05 m): 2.2 m.

sign.value: 2.5 m wide, 0.42 m high, round the top
sign.source: Photo 0 (2014): the red sign is 61 px wide and 10 px high at the scale of the scooter: 2.5 m and 0.42 m; it is wider than the body. That it goes round the four sides: estimate (no source).

roof_height.source: Photo 0 (2014): a low green roof of about 6 px over the sign at the scale of the scooter: 0.23 m.

height.source: Photo 0 (2014): 69 px from the sidewalk to the top of the roof at the scale of the scooter: 2.85 m; with the base: 2.9 m.

colors.value: panels #86beb6, frame #5e9a92, sign #b3312a with an orange panel #cf6a35 at its left end, roof #5b7f5c
colors.source: Photo 0 (2014), on a dark day under trees: light blue green panels in a darker frame (a rail at half height, posts), a red sign with white letters that cannot be read and an orange panel at its left end, a green roof. The values are a little lighter than the medians of the photo (#35493c, #411e15, #67422c), for the light of a clear day.

looks.seen: Next to photo 0: a light blue green box of panels with a red sign band, wider than the body, under a low green roof, as the photo. With the colors at the points of a mid mesh, the dark frame of the panels makes soft diagonal smears, the orange panel bleeds into the red sign, and the roof shows dents.
looks.changed: I gave the near and mid levels maps (a bake of 1024 and 256), so the frame, the sign and the roof have sharp colors and smooth normals.

looks.seen: With the maps, the frame of the panels (a rail at half height and a post in the middle of each side), the red sign and the green roof are sharp, and the proportions agree with photo 0 (the body 1.15 times as high as wide). But the orange panel of the sign and the door are at the right end of the front, and photo 0 shows the orange panel at the left end.
looks.changed: I moved the orange panel, the lines of letters and the door to the other half of the front (+x is on the left for a person in front of the kiosk).

looks.seen: The orange panel is now at the left end of the front sign, as photo 0. The mid level agrees with the photo.
looks.changed: Nothing at the mid level. The near level stopped the builder of the factory five times (HTTP 503: more memory than the edge has), with a bake of 1024, then 512, with cells of 0.015 m and 0.02 m, and with four material roles. I made one role (part_01) with a finish on each edit, cells of 0.035 m at near, and the handle of the door a detail with its own small cells.

looks.seen: The same mid level: the panels in their frame, the red sign with the orange panel at its left end, the low green roof.

The near level: the door in the left half of the front with its handle, the frame of the panels, a thin white line between the orange panel and the red, and two light bands in the place of the letters (the words of photo 0 cannot be read). The bands are brighter and more even than the small letters of the photo.
looks.changed: Nothing (one build of the near level). The bands of the letters can be fainter in a later version.

status_note: Check (report 0026, Q17): only the photo of 2014-04-06 shows the kiosk. No photo of 2017 or later shows it: the search of 2026-11-17 (Flickr, 2017 to 2021: Bãi Trước, Quang Trung, the park; Wikimedia Commons: a photo of Quang Trung of 2024-03-03 and the photos of 2022 of the walks by the sea; the photo from a drone of 2021-01-30 at 3 840 px) found none. In the photo from a drone, the sidewalk of the park on Quang Trung has new tiles in a check pattern, and no kiosk with a green roof shows on it. Its place in 2019 is not known (Q2).
